messages:
kai-infra: Heads up — planning a maintenance blitz next Tue 02:00-05:00 UTC. We'll be rolling a small GPU microcode + BMC patch across several racks. Expect soft reboots and short warmup-induced throughput drops (minutes per rack). Goal is no customer-visible downtime, but p95 token latency may spike briefly during warms.

alex: Thanks. What's our capacity headroom during that window? Any regions we should avoid scheduling high-traffic jobs in?

juno: Checked capacity: eu-west2 and eu-central are tight (~8-12% spare), us-east and apac1 have ~25-35% spare. Suggest doing the initial canary in us-east then move to eu with slower cadence.

ops-oncall: Canary plan: 5 racks in us-east for 1h. If p95 < 1.5x baseline and error-rate < 0.1%, proceed. Fallback lanes configured to route burst traffic to dedicated-burst pools. We'll have oncall watching dashboards and auto-fallback enabled.

maria: Note cost tradeoffs: running backfill on dedicated-burst for the window will increase short-term GPU spend (rough estimate +14% for the maintenance hour). Also recommend throttling scheduled batch embed jobs 01:00-06:00 UTC to avoid compounding warms. @alex please confirm if product can shift heavy jobs. :warning:

alex: I can gate non-urgent batch embeds. I'll push a note to the scheduler team to pause/shift.

kai-infra: Operational checklist (condensed):
```
# cordon + drain (safe drain)
kubectl cordon NODE
kubectl drain NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120
# small-window bump: increase replica weight to dedicated-burst service for traffic during node drain
```
Also: pre-warm KV prefixes for common LL workloads 30min before each rack drain.

juno: On warmup: we'll run a lightweight preheat script (2 requests/sec per GPU for 15m) to populate KV caches. That reduces p95 spikes from warm starts. Script will hit /internal/preheat endpoint, token-limited.

ops-oncall: Alerting: will create a maintenance incident with SLACK tag #maintenance and hook to pager if fallback triggers. Also updating status page if fallback >5%.

sre-bot: Deploy bot: maintenance scheduled at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z — canary start. Will post step updates to #eng-infra and #incidents.

maria: Customer comms: Draft note for customers with high-throughput SLAs drafted. Recommend sending a 48h heads-up to Dedicated customers and a 6h micro-update to hosted users who have traffic peaks in EU window.

kai-infra: Final asks: 
- @juno double-check preheat script environment limits
- @ops-oncall ensure fallback route has enough capacity (>20% reserved)
- @alex confirm batch shift scheduled
- @maria prep status page and customer emails
Respond with thumbs up when you have these locked. :thumbsup:

alex: Locking batch shifts now, will ping when done. :thumbsup:

juno: Preheat env checks done, script limits set. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Fallback reserve set to 22%. Monitoring + runbook attached to incident. :thumbsup:

maria: Drafts queued for 48h and 6h comms. Will publish after your final signoff. :thumbsup:
